obligations.source_text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

bindings.mirror_plane_phrase: a visible mirror edge thickness seam or reflected-room discontinuity establishes one physical reflective plane inside the planetarium corridor
bindings.mirror_subject_phrase: one clearly adult subject's face hair and body appear inside that same reflected space beside the radio station
bindings.mirror_device_phrase: the reflected subject visibly grips one phone and the hand-to-device contact remains anatomically coherent during the unfinished tuning action
bindings.mirror_gaze_phrase: reflection gaze phone placement and any facial occlusion agree with the mirror geometry across the visible seam
bindings.mirror_boundary_phrase: a direct selfie empty mirror detached phone phone-screen image or software border does not substitute for the room-scale physical reflection

bindings.under_eye_pigment_phrase: bilateral cosmetic color occupies both upper cheeks directly below the lower eyelids in a soft rose hue
bindings.under_eye_boundary_phrase: a narrow clean skin boundary keeps pigment outside the eye and lower-lid margin on both sides
bindings.under_eye_edge_phrase: the cheek pigment has controlled soft cosmetic edges and a readable blush hue under mixed corridor light
bindings.under_eye_confound_phrase: dark circles fatigue shadow tears irritation and generalized redness do not substitute for the bilateral cosmetic distribution

bindings.sheer_correction_phrase: a thin cosmetic layer lightly evens broad complexion tone without opaque masking across the visible face
bindings.sheer_texture_phrase: pores fine texture and small surface irregularities remain visible through the correction at native inspection
bindings.sheer_variation_phrase: subtle local natural color variation remains instead of one uniform painted skin color across cheeks and forehead
bindings.sheer_boundary_phrase: surface shine lighting and grading remain separate and literal transparency blur overexposure or plastic smoothing does not substitute for low cosmetic coverage
